title: 1Password coordinate data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/secrets.yaml. Merged into the same template data as hosts.yaml. Names a vault and the items templates read; it cannot tell whether either exists, since only `op` knows that.

items.description: Short key -> 1Password item title, identity-mapped. The key is what templates write (.secrets.items.slskd); a hyphenated key needs `index`. A typo is caught at render time by missingkey=error.
